src: She's one of the Collectors. Heptarch even. She took over their Villa here in the city decades ago.
Hevla is friends with a lot of people, unlike the other Heptarchs. Those are a selfish bunch, according to what I heard.
Hevla is interested in how we, the Titans, formed communities, among humans and people of the flesh.
She entered my realm in pursuit of research.
What was the research?
I think it began with Morrowmeat and his sorry state. According to Hevla it's more of a sickness. Something rotten.
She examined me on a molecular level. And I bade my children to offer themselves for examination, too.
You have to ask Hevla herself what this is all about.
I think she might have been looking for a cure.
You mentioned she's gone. How can she help us?
Well, she... She mentioned once, not without pride, how her personal arsenal can only be unlocked by her own mind.
So I copied that part of her mind.
The part which I think could be used for a mind contraption like that.
I know that you can handle memories. You brought Morrowmeat's memory to us.
If you promise that you will use it for the greater good of the city, I will entrust you with Hevla's engram.
Sure.
Then let me enter your mind...
You have a beautiful mind, my child.
I trust that you will be careful with Hevla's Engram.
So where do I find Hevla's arsenal?
It's in the villa of the Collectors.
Up there in the city.
I have come for your engram.
How bold.
But you won't get it. Not without a fight.
I make you a counterproposal: Ask me about Hevla instead.
I could give you something that would help us both.
[Try suppressing Mother's mind to get her engram.]
{You succeed in suppressing Mother's mind.}
Apart from Mother's engram you also find a memory imprint matching the Heptarch Hevla.
No. I'll kill you instead.
This will be the end of you, my child.
Alright. I'm curious about Hevla.
I gave you Hevla's engram. Isn't that enough already?
The humans need your help.
Humans always need help from someone. I have witnessed this again and again.
I cannot take care of all the children on this world.
They are oppressed by the Machine Guardians.
I know. And it fills me with sorrow—to see all these precious children crushed, forced into submission by cold metal and unfeeling algorithms.
But I don't have the means to change that. My power is limited to my own temple these days. You need to get help from someone else.
The one you should turn your attention to is Heptarch Hevla, even if she's not around at the moment.
The Collectors have hoarded an arsenal of technology. I know this because Hevla has visited me in pursuit of research and has shared details about her capabilities.
Welcome, my child.
Don't dawdle around there. Come and show me your face.
I have watched your progress. Well done for a small one. Well done.
But why are you doing this? Why all this effort?
Which effort?
Coming down here all this way. There's not much to see apart from grizzled old me.
I wonder about the purpose of your visit.
Uhhhm.
{She stares at you with vacant eyes.}
What else do you want to know about Hevla?
Why are they cutting up the Titan like that?
Because of the meat. We eat meat. To survive. So we cut off a few pieces of that quarry guy. Simple.
The machines won't provide us with anything else so we have to take care of it ourselves.
Couldn't you get it somewhere else? There's a lot of meat in this world that's not part of some quarry guy.
But the meat from the quarry guy tastes great. I like it.
And I told you already: the machines won't come up with any other food. We are totally on our own here.
What about other food?
There's no other food.
Did you ever go out there and look for other food?
Us humans? Procuring our own food?
Haha. That's wild. Why would we though? The machines take care of us.
Well, it wasn't always like that.
Are you talking about human history or what?
Yeah, kind of.
Where are you from? Did you grow up taking care of your own food?
No. I grew up in one of the Silent Cities.
And who took care of the food?
The machines.
See, you're one of us, kind of.
What's this place?
It's where we get our food.
You are new here, I guess. Well, watch out.
Be nice to the machines. I don't want any interruptions to my regular feedings.
Do you know where to get a reflux filter?
Huh?
The Titan Support System over there needs a new one.
Does this mean the Titan is experiencing some difficulties?
Probably.
Oh, that's bad. Hopefully it doesn't affect the quality of the meat.
So?
So what?
The reflux filter?
I don't know what a reflux filter is. But I guess the system here was installed by the Machines, same as the rest.
I've heard they get their parts at the Factory, in the north of the city.
But we're not allowed to walk around there.
Alright.
Hey.
What's going on in this place?
It's a Cyberwomb. People of the city use it to get their fix.
This Cyberwomb stuff is nice... It's not like the real thing, of course.
What's the real thing?
I remember being connected to Omniwomb. THAT was real. Wow. The stuff of legends.
My friends and me diving through the planes of chaos, dancing on the fields of heaven. Living to the beat.
Being awake all night until we passed out. At least you don't have to walk home if you're in the Omniwomb, haha.
Then, on the next day, off to new adventures. Browsing the latest shit.
Do you have adventures here in this world, too?
Sure. I have all sorts of exciting days. The city is beautiful, does have its perks. But I think it's too dangerous beyond the city.
There's all sorts of violence and stuff.
Like... maniacs wandering around.
Have you heard about a Titan machine entering the city?
A Titan entering the city? No, I have not. Now that would be a sight I'm sure I would not forget.
You say 'machine'. Is it a hybrid? Oh my god. Imagine the machines and the mutants cooperating.
Those fuckers! Where would that leave us humans?
We need to be ready for that. For the worst case scenario.
We should own the means to fight for our rights. With violence, if necessary.
I don't think so.
Bah. What are you? A pacifist?
Well, I might have an idea about where to start.
Yes, I agree.
A fine taste? Sounds like you need someone who appreciates good food.
Ask Hudde over there in the east of the Market. She knows all about meat.
Forget about it. The Collectors have overtaken the Administration.
This changes a lot. But we'll have to see in what way.
Scout the Administration, find any weakness, and observe its military strength.
I have finished investigating the Administration.
Aha. AHA!
Tell me everything.
Yes, this will help us a lot. I thank you.
I think it's about time you meet some of my friends.
Go over to the Residential Area. There's this rough looking guy hanging out in front of a door.
Tell him that Protas sent you, and he'll know you're one of us.
Alright.
So what's that idea you mentioned?
What I propose is simple: We take control of the city. For ourselves. The humans.
We are not alone in this. There are other people, friends of mine, already planning for contingencies.
Look, I'm not saying that it has to be violent. At first.
What we need to start with is a bit of good old reconnoitering. Are you in?
What exactly would I be in for?
Taking a peek at the Administration. A fresh face will be less suspicious than mine.
Eh, alright. Come back if you remember for which team you're supposed to be playing here.
OK. I think I can do that.
That's the spirit. Now, what I need you to do: Scout the Administration, find any weakness, and observe its military strength.
Will do.
Good luck.
You mentioned meeting some of your friends...
The humans overthrew the Administration.
Yes. Indeed. You did us a solid there.
I kind of guessed that you would be one of those people helping out if a community is in need. And that you couldn't stand those machine fuckers either.
I saw that in you. Right from the start.
Well done, my friend. Well done.
I feel great relief about this.
So what's next?
Rebuilding. Gonna take some time and effort. For now we're allowed to have a bit of rest without a machine eye leering at us.
You there. You are new around here. I haven't seen you before.
I welcome you to the exalted metropolis.
Enjoy being a human around other humans here. If they let you.
They?
The machines. They make a nice appearance at first.
But that iron fist is waiting for you if you move somewhere you're not supposed to be.
All for our protection, as they are wont to say. But doesn't that feel more like oppression?
Enter off-limit areas and they'll shoot you without warning. Build a garden to grow some meat-alternative and they'll destroy it because of 'health' issues.
That's on top of not being able to have children and of not being able to access technology that historically belonged to us humans.
We used to own this whole planet, including this capital.
Now look at us!
Lately, we are not even allowed to leave the capital, and I guess the same goes for entering.
You are actually the first new face I have seen in a long while.
Well, sorry for chewing your ear off.
What do you want to know?
I need to concentrate and figure this out.
Please leave me alone.
Leave me alone.
I just need time. Lots of it.
And the sooner you get out of my sight, the sooner I will be left to my own ponderings, and be able to focus again.
What are you pondering about?
The flesh growth. Where it came from. Where it's going. Why it's gonna overwhelm us.
So did you find any answers yet?
Not really.
But one question bothers me even more than the others.
The question of how we might be able to revert the whole thing.
Basically, how to exterminate the flesh completely.
